filter.comment: Episode = the _ego recording stem (e.g. CF3-A4-20240802_User1_240802092926). Ignore _exo. FALSE-token episodes are INCLUDED (they carry full ego video+gaze+anno). ~7902 ego videos.

projection.notes: 70-column Tobii-style eye-tracker + IMU export. 2D gaze = 'Gaze Point X[px]'/'Gaze Point Y[px]' in absolute pixels (invalid sentinel -1.0). RESOLVED: gaze pixel space == ego video frame == 1280x960 (ffprobe of 4 takes across sessions: all 1280x960; binocular gaze X hard-bounded <1260, Y only 0.16% past 960 — the signature of gaze-space==frame; my earlier 'not 1280x960' was from noisier per-EYE columns, not primary gaze). frame_dims=[1280,960] is constant; a per-episode ffprobe assertion (warn on mismatch) is cheap insurance. VIDEO fps VARIES per take (~28.09-29.85, r_frame_rate==avg_frame_rate, odd ratios like 2881/100) -> ffprobe per-episode; do NOT hardcode fps. The ~125 Hz is only the Tobii gaze sample rate (irrelevant to the frame timeline). 'Video Time[HH:mm:ss.ms]' = decimal HH:MM:SS.mmm starting at 0 = video start, shares the annotation clock. Pupil Position cols are normalized [0,1] (sentinel -1.0), carry NO frame-size info. IMU bundled as semicolon-delimited subfields.

join.comment: total.json = {annotations, action_label, scene_label}. annotations[<name>.mp4] (ego AND exo keys, ext included). Coarse-level is a single string spanning the whole take; no per-segment timing -> one interval over [0, Duration]. Strip leading 'C:' prefix (raw kept).

Fine-level = list of steps; each {Step discription (sic, misspelled), Step timestamp:[start,end], Step order}. Timestamps in seconds from video start (align with Duration). Strip leading 'T:'/'F:' prefix (raw kept).

video_metadata_rule.resolution: 1280x960 constant (ffprobe-confirmed; gaze pixel space == this frame).
video_metadata_rule.fps: VARIES per take (~28-30); ffprobe avg_frame_rate per-episode, do not hardcode.
video_metadata_rule.duration_s: shipped total.json per-entry 'Duration' (seconds); ffprobe to cross-check.

metadata.notes: Per-episode metadata (Scene, Action, Duration, View, Split, Video type) lives in total.json's per-entry dict. Split available per-entry ('Split') and as train/val/test.json.

provenance.notes: METADATA none. VIDEO Video/. GAZE Gaze_IMU/. ANNOTATION Annotaton/total.json (by mp4 name): COARSE Coarse-level (one channel); FINE Fine-level with Step description + Step timestamp [start,end] (second channel). NOTE: use only ego (not exo). FALSE = 'impersonated incorrectly' per README; include FALSE episodes if data exists.
decisions: Episode = _ego stem; FALSE episodes included (full data present).
Gaze 2D = 'Gaze Point X/Y[px]' (pixels, invalid -1.0) from the 70-col Tobii+IMU csv; per-eye gaze, pupil, validity, and IMU preserved as extras.
Two annotation channels: coarse (single whole-take string -> [0,Duration]) and fine (per-step intervals).
Strip leading 'C:'/'T:'/'F:' prefixes from text; raw retained.
corrections: Dir is 'Annotation' (notes said 'Annotaton'); per-video map is nested under 'annotations' key, not the JSON root.
total.json keys include the .mp4 extension and cover both ego and exo -> filter to *_ego.mp4 keys.
Fine step description key is misspelled 'Step discription'.
Gaze is a 70-column eye-tracker+IMU export, far richer than x,y; use Gaze Point X/Y[px].
open_questions: RESOLVED: gaze frame == video frame == 1280x960 (constant; ffprobe-confirmed on 4 takes + tail analysis of 140k gaze rows). fps varies per take (28-30) -> ffprobe per-episode.
No README on this server: 'FALSE/impersonated' meaning unverified (empirically FALSE = subject token, Video type:false, full data present).
